networkPolicy.desc: PostHog analytics is blocked; calls and dispatch stay open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. Flutter, on the Startach platform. What it needs: api-prod.startach.io, api-yedidim.startach.io, yedidim.startach.io, redirect.startach.io, platform.startach.org.il, Google Maps, Firebase and Sentry. Blocked: PostHog, product analytics that can also record sessions. On launch it reached only Firebase and Sentry, before sign in, so the hosts used after sign in were not seen.
